# Sakuga VFX

> Ordinary UI controls that react like anime: squash and overshoot on springs, and drawn effects (smoke, impact bursts, slashes, splashes) with manga sound-effect lettering, on one canvas over the page. Each is one plain script that registers a custom element: no dependencies, no build step, no other files to fetch. MIT licensed.

[Gallery](gallery/) · [Project repository](https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n) · [Upstream Sakuga VFX](https://github.com/finktheartist/sakuga-vfx) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

## Drop-in components

Copy a component file from this repository into your project. The file links below are relative to this document. Load the file with a plain script tag (not as a module), and include the MIT license with any copies you redistribute. Each file carries the shared core; the first one loaded sets window.SakugaFX and the rest reuse it, so any mix shares one canvas and one loop.

Set `<html lang>` to `en`, `zh-CN`, or `ja` to select the embedded sound-effect lettering. Missing lettering falls back to the original Japanese sprite.

- [Button](button/button.js): A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. `<sakuga-button>`: <sakuga-button>Confirm</sakuga-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. [Docs](button/README.md)
- [Toggle](toggle/toggle.js): A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). `<sakuga-toggle>`: <sakuga-toggle label="Notifications"></sakuga-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](toggle/README.md)
- [Slider](slider/slider.js): A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. `<sakuga-slider>`: <sakuga-slider value="30" label="Volume"></sakuga-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](slider/README.md)
- [Checkbox](checkbox/checkbox.js): A checkbox that slashes: crescents swing round the box, crystals fly, the tick draws itself, and ズザッ lands in dotted letters. `<sakuga-checkbox>`: <sakuga-checkbox>Remember me</sakuga-checkbox>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](checkbox/README.md)
- [Radio](radio/radio.js): A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. `<sakuga-radio>`: <sakuga-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></sakuga-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](radio/README.md)
- [Input](input/input.js): A text field that kicks up a puff of dust from the caret on every key. `<sakuga-input>`: <sakuga-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></sakuga-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](input/README.md)
- [Tabs](tabs/tabs.js): Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. `<sakuga-tabs>`: <sakuga-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></sakuga-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. [Docs](tabs/README.md)
- [Progress](progress/progress.js): A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. `<sakuga-progress>`: <sakuga-progress label="Loading"></sakuga-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for sakuga:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. [Docs](progress/README.md)
- [Rating](rating/rating.js): Five stars that pop in one after another, with wedges and a hollow ポン on the last; five gets a burst. `<sakuga-rating>`: <sakuga-rating label="Rating"></sakuga-rating>. Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](rating/README.md)
- [Toast](toast/toast.js): A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. `<sakuga-toast>`: Put <sakuga-toast></sakuga-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). [Docs](toast/README.md)
- [Tooltip](tooltip/tooltip.js): A help button whose hint springs out like a speech bubble, with puffs and a hollow カチッ. `<sakuga-tooltip>`: <sakuga-tooltip text="Helpful hint!"></sakuga-tooltip>. Opens on hover, focus and tap; Escape closes it. [Docs](tooltip/README.md)

Colours are --sk-* CSS variables; a page's own :root values win. Effects switch off for prefers-reduced-motion.
